programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: A poor couple, Shui and Ti, try to make a life on their own. And through both of their hard work, Shui becomes a marketing executive, then his attitude begins to change.

programme.title: Royal Tramp 2
programme.desc: Wei the jester, turned undercover spy, turned high ranking official in the Chinese imperial court, tries his best to deal with warring factions and deadly martial artists all vying for power.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: The story is about a powerful drug-lord in southeast Asia, and the good guys have to save their loved ones under the threat of the Drug business conspiracy.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: A model (Joey Wong) gets raped by a photographer (Wilson Lam). Meanwhile, she falls out with her best friend (Carol Cheng) due to her boyfriend (Alex Man), who's a cop.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus accept a job from their landlord: kidnap a baby. Soon, the baby awakens strong paternal feelings in the two crooks, leading to complications when it comes to handing him over to his possibly crazy gang boss grandfather.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: In 1920s China, a bandit arrives in a remote provincial town posing as its new mayor, where he faces off against a tyrannical local nobleman.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Security guard Lee Go is assigned to keep guard at a house while the owner is away. However, a series of hilarious misunderstandings occur.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh joins the carefree Spinsters’ Club when she discovers her husband is having an affair. Despite the seemingly happy front that her sisters put on, beneath it all, each of them secretly yearns for a man in her life.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Behind The Yellow Line

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: As a bounty of HKD 100 million is made to hunt down the biggest drug dealer in the city, Hong Kong becomes the battleground for the fight between good and evil.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino is a mediocre con artist who crosses paths with Kwan, a fellow con artist. Together, they impersonate various people and create numerous schemes to make money. Meanwhile, gangsters are making a scheme of their own.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle follows a martial arts instructor who is imprisoned after a fatal accident. When a serial killer begins targeting martial arts masters, he offers his help to the police in exchange for freedom. A deadly game of skill and survival unfolds as he confronts the killer using his mastery of kung fu.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter-the sole witness-mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: A young Chinese warrior steals a sword from a famed swordsman and then escapes into a world of romantic adventure with a mysterious man in the frontier of the nation.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: God Of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: Multi talented Cho wants to learn from the God of Gamblers and contacts his disciple. They are attacked by a crime boss with a plan to misuse GoG's good name to make millions.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: A veteran comedian's last chance at stardom takes him on the road with a young comic who reveals an unexpected past.

programme.title: The Folks
programme.desc: Mary receives a visit from his brother and mother, whom she had never met previously, following her husband's funeral. Mary finds out that her late husband's relatives are harmful for both herself and her son Tony.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: A young woman must save herself and her friends from an ancient evil that stalks its victims through the real-life phenomenon of sleep paralysis.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: On the death of his father, Tim Webber returns to his childhood village in Somerset to find something sinister is disturbing the idyllic peace of the villagers.

programme.title: Winter War

programme.title: The Ballad Of Davy Crockett
programme.desc: In 1815, an American Legend, whose wife has fallen deathly ill, leaving his young children to survive on their own, must fight his way back to them across the many perils found in the Savage Lands of the wild frontier.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: No Visitors
programme.desc: Respected surgeon Lewis Cutterman hides a dark secret. His family drugs guests and slowly consumes them, harvesting organs to sell for desperate patients in a twisted family business.

programme.title: The Last Son
programme.desc: An outlaw attempts to end his evil family line.

programme.title: Call Me King
programme.desc: In the international world of gun running loyalty, honor and discretion are valuable commodities, but nothing is more priceless than the bond of family. Power begets enemies and a loved ones betrayal cuts like a knife. Sides will be chosen, wars will be fought. In the end, there can only be one King.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: A specialist carrier is hired to deliver a mysterious case to the underworld's most dangerous hitman.

programme.title: Murder Syndicate
programme.desc: When the matriarch of a family of assassins falls ill, her three children and younger boyfriend fight among themselves to take over her empire.

programme.title: Havenhurst
programme.desc: A troubled young woman takes up residence in a gothic apartment building where she must confront a terrifying evil.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A farmer takes in an injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse comes for the money, he must decide who to trust. Defending a siege, he reveals a gunslinging talent calling his true identity into question.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: American gangster Erik Vasquez is scheming to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu, an ambitious young man who dreams of being a professional hip-hop dancer. When his father issues an ultimatum, Tu decides that dance is his way out.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
programme.desc: When Alma returns home to help her family get their Native American heritage recognized, all she finds is the World-Famous Clown Motel that has been erected on their land.

programme.title: AfterDeath
programme.desc: After a tragic accident inside a nightclub, five people wake up dead on a beach. Frightened and confused, they desperately try to make sense of things and wonder if they are actually in hell.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Set during World War 2, a squad of American Army soldiers are sent on a mission behind lines to locate their missing commanding officer.

programme.title: Temple
programme.desc: Three American tourists follow a mysterious map deep into the jungles of Japan searching for an ancient temple. When spirits entrap them, their adventure quickly becomes a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Hacker
programme.desc: With the help of his new friends Alex Danyliuk turns to a life of crime and identity theft.

programme.title: Phoenix
programme.desc: Jean Grey begins to develop incredible powers that corrupt and turn her into a Dark Phoenix, causing the X-Men to have to decide if her life is worth more than all of humanity.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful fiancée embarks on an affair with his best friend.

programme.title: The Great War
programme.desc: During the last days of the Great War, a group of U.S. soldiers are sent behind enemy lines to rescue a lost platoon.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Clean

programme.title: Death On The Border
programme.desc: Two determined women vie to escape their abusive relationships with a dirty Detective at rock bottom, determined to move sex trafficked girls over the Mexican border.

programme.title: Pineapple Express (Galaxy Premium)

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2 (Galaxy Premium)

programme.title: The Craft: Legacy (Galaxy Premium)

programme.title: Life

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: A failed reporter is bonded to an alien entity, one of many symbiotes who have invaded Earth. But the being takes a liking to Earth and decides to protect it.

programme.title: That's My Boy

programme.title: The Intruder

programme.title: The Dark Tower

programme.title: Straw Dogs

programme.title: The International

programme.title: Resident Evil: Damnation (Galaxy Premium)

programme.title: S.W.A.T. (Galaxy Premium)

programme.title: Blumhouse's Fantasy Island

programme.title: Dunia Dalam Cerita
programme.desc: Program Dokumenter Edukatif Yang Mengajak Pemirsa Untuk Menelusuri Kembali Lembaran Sejarah Dan Mengungkap Berbagai Rahasia Besar Serta Kisah Tak Terduga Yang Tersimpan Di Seluruh Dunia. Di Balik Setiap Peristiwa Besar Dan Tokoh-Tokoh Ikonik Masa Lalu, Selalu Ada Sisi Cerita Tersembunyi Yang Jarang Diketahui Oleh Publik.

programme.title: Kokom (Kompilasi Komedi)
programme.desc: Program Yang Berisikan Kompilasi Video-Video Lucu Yang Viral Di Sosial Media.

programme.title: Terang Kasih
programme.desc: Siraman Rohani Kristen Yang Berkaitan Dengan Kehidupan Untuk Mendekatkan Diri Kepada Tuhan Yesus Kristus. Program Ini Akan Dibagi Menjadi Beberapa Bagian, Antara Lain Kesaksian, Renungan, Serta Konseling Yang Akan Dipandu Oleh Dua Orang Host

programme.title: Movinesia
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Yang Menghadirkan Sederet Film Pilihan Untuk Menemani Aktivitas Anda Dengan Dimeriahkan Oleh Para Pemain & Artis Papan Atas Berbakat, Dengan Cerita Ringan Seputar Kehidupan Remaja.

programme.title: Ustadz On The Road
programme.desc: Program Religi Yang Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Ustadz Yang Akan Memberikan Kajian Islami Dengan Treatment On The Road Disertai Dengan Study Kasus. Pembahasan Dilakukan Sepanjang Perjalanan Menuju Lokasi Sesuai Agenda Harian Ustadz. Program Ini Akan Disajikan Secara Ringan Dan Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Perjuangan Jett Dan Timnya Dalam Melindungi Bumi Dan Luar Angkasa Dari Golden Boy, Yang Berhasil Mencuri Sumber Energi Kosmik Kuat Bernama Star Core. Dengan Kekuatan Star Core, Golden Boy Melompati Dimensi Ruang-Waktu Dan Mengancam Keseimbangan Alam Semesta. Untuk Menghentikannya, Tim Super Wings Harus Meluncurkan Markas Besar Ruang Angkasa Mereka, Menjelajahi Berbagai Dimensi Ekstrem, Hingga Terlibat Dalam Pertempuran Robot Raksasa Demi Merebut Kembali Energi Tersebut Dan Menyelamatkan Dunia.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Beyblade X S2
programme.desc: Tim Persona Yang Kembali Berjuang Menaklukkan X Tower, Di Tengah Guncangan Besar Dunia Beyblade Pasca-Pertarungan Sengit Melawan Ryugu Kuromu.

programme.title: Beyblade X S3
programme.desc: Beyblade X Mengikuti Ancaman Baru Dari Zero Cross (Zero Kurasu) Dan Keluarganya Yang Berencana Membangun X Tower Baru Demi Sistem Beyblade Tandingan Dan Menghancurkan Menara Lama. Team Persona Harus Berjuang Melindungi X Tower Asli Dengan Menghadapi Anak-Anak Zero.

programme.title: Ultraman Teo
programme.desc: Ultraman Teo Menceritakan Tentang Alien Kesepian Bernama Teo Yang Melarikan Diri Ke Bumi Setelah Planet Asalnya Hancur Diserang Kaiju. Di Bumi, Ia Hidup Sebagai Ibuki Mitsuishi, Seorang Mahasiswa Kedokteran Hewan Yang Berjuang Beradaptasi Dengan Manusia. Saat Monster Yang Sama Menyerang Bumi, Tekadnya Melindungi Makhluk Hidup Mengubahnya Menjadi Ultraman.

programme.title: Hunter X Hunter
programme.desc: Kisah Hunter Hunter Berfokus Pada Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Bernama Gon Freecss, Yang Suatu Hari Menemukan Bahwa Ayahnya Yang Selama Ini Diberitahu Telah Meninggal, Masih Hidup Dan Sehat. Dia Mengetahui Bahwa Ayahnya, Ging Freecss, Adalah Seorang Hunter Legendaris. Terlepas Dari Kenyataan Bahwa Ayahnya Meninggalkan Gon Bersama Kerabatnya Untuk Mengejar Mimpinya, Gon Bertekad Untuk Mengikuti Jejak Ayahnya, Lulus Ujian Hunter, Dan Akhirnya Menemukan Ayahnya Untuk Membuktikan Dirinya Sebagai Hunter Dengan Haknya Sendiri.

programme.title: Mtlb Goo!
programme.desc: Program Magazine Yang Mengeksplor Tempat-Tempat Unik Dan Mendatangi Orang-Orang Dengan Kisah Menarik. Dikemas Dalam Bentuk Cerita Perjalanan Michael Tjandra Bersama Para Sahabat. Sehingga Selain Banyaknya Informasi Yang Diberikan, Keseruan Pengalaman Perjalanan Michael Tjandra Juga Dihadirkan Kepada Penonton.
